notes:
Puts the lobby wait back where it was.

1.9.0 let the bus leave as soon as the lobby stopped filling. That measured the wrong thing: you count as "joined" the moment your connection is accepted, but your game then spends a long time loading the island before it can show you anything. The lobby wait is most of that head start, and cutting it short just moved the waiting to a screen with no countdown on it.

Back to back on the same machine: the old wait gave the game 53 seconds to load before the bus left, the new one gave it 18. Nothing looked wrong on the server either way — both reached the bus — but on screen the second one was still loading right through the flight.

So the wait goes back to its previous length. The player-count tracking stays in the log, because it is what a proper fix will need.

Everything else from 1.9.0 is unchanged, including the region-aware hosting fix.
